specs.英文简介: Schiansky Feinmechanik was a maker of tripods for medium- to large-format cameras in Munich at least from the post-War period until the late 1960s, and also made some studio cameras.[https://auction-team.de/wp-content/uploads/eCatalogue/PH_II_2018/mobile/index.html#p=122 Schiansky 18x24cm Universal-Atelierkamera] (studio camera), dated to 1948-50 by the auctioneer [https://auction-team.de/ Breker]
